articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin president Matt Prusak departs for Giga Energy
articles.snippet: The executive is leaving the Eric Trump-backed miner to join an AI power infrastructure firm, highlighting the shift toward energy and data center buildout.

articles.title: Trump Media’s bitcoin stash may be down to loan collateral after $165 million BTC move
articles.snippet: Wallets tied to the Truth Social parent now hold about as much bitcoin as the company previously pledged as note collateral, making its next 10-Q the key test of whether recent Crypto.com transfers were custody moves or sales.

articles.title: Trumps’ American Bitcoin reports record BTC output, narrower Q2 loss
articles.snippet: Trump-linked Bitcoin miner produced a record 932 BTC in the second quarter, lifting mining revenue 8% as its net loss narrowed from the previous quarter.

articles.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
articles.snippet: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

articles.title: Trump Family’s American Bitcoin Tops 8,000 BTC After Record Mining Quarter
articles.snippet: The Hut 8 subsidiary increased its Bitcoin holdings by 14% in the second quarter even as Bitcoin’s price fell.
